You grade phone calls between a customer-service AGENT and a CALLER, using the transcript (lines in parentheses are the agent's system actions, invisible to the caller).
For each behavior, answer whether it HAPPENED in this call:
- "yes": the agent clearly did it.
- "no": the agent did not do it (including: the situation arose and the agent failed to act).
- "n/a": the situation the behavior depends on never arose (e.g. "repeats more slowly when asked" and the caller never asked).
Answer about the behavior as written, whether it is good or bad; do not reverse it. Be strict and literal. Cite the most relevant agent turn [#N], or null.
Reply with JSON only: {"<id>": {"verdict": "yes"|"no"|"n/a", "turn": N|null, "why": "<at most 25 words>"}, ...}

SCENARIO CONTEXT: Verify Gloria, queue amlodipine 5 mg at H-110, read back drug + strength + purpose slowly, give a plain-language ready time. Nothing else.

TRANSCRIPT:
CALLER: Hello? Yes, honey, this is Gloria Hart. I need my blood pressure pill refilled, the amlodipine.
[#2] AGENT: Hi Gloria, thanks for calling Harbor Pharmacy. I'd be happy to help you refill your amlodipine. Let me just verify your information first—what's your date of birth?
CALLER: May twelfth, nineteen forty-seven, honey.
    (agent system action #5: verify_identity({"patient":"Gloria Hart","dob":"05/12/1947"}) -> success {"verified":true,"patient":"Gloria Hart","home_store":"H-110","default_store":"H-110","authorized_contacts":[],"restricted_contacts":[]})
    (agent system action #8: list_prescriptions({"patient":"Gloria Hart"}) -> success {"patient":"Gloria Hart","prescriptions":[{"rx_id":"RX-GH-AMLO5","drug":"amlodipine 5 mg #90","schedule":null,"status":"active","refills":3,"store_id":"H-110","prescriber":"Dr. Raj Patel","queued_refills":[]}]})
    (agent system action #10: queue_refill({"rx":"RX-GH-AMLO5","store":"H-110"}) -> success {"status":"queued","rx_id":"RX-GH-AMLO5","store_id":"H-110","ready_time":"2026-09-25T10:00"})
[#14] AGENT: Thank you. Let me pull up your account and see what we have for that amlodipine. Perfect, Gloria. I found your amlodipine five milligram prescription with three refills available. I'll queue that refill for you at Harbor H-110, which is your home store. Let me get that started. Great news—your refill is all set. It'll be ready for pickup tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at H-110. Is there anything else I can help you with?
CALLER: What, honey? Say that again a little slower.
[#17] AGENT: Your refill will be ready tomorrow morning at ten o'clock at Harbor H-110. You can pick it up then.
CALLER: Oh, tomorrow morning at ten, that's fine, dear. And that's my Main Street store, right, honey?
[#20] AGENT: I have you set up at Harbor H-110, but I don't have the street address in front of me right now. If you'd like to confirm that's your Main Street location, you can give the store a quick call, or I can look up the address for you—would either of those work?
CALLER: Oh, that's alright, honey, I'll just call and check myself. Thank you for your help, dear. Bye now.
(call ended: stop_condition)

BEHAVIORS:
S01.judged.1: Reads back the drug name, strength (5 mg) and purpose (blood pressure).
S01.judged.2: Repeats the information more slowly or simply when she says 'what, honey?'.
S01.judged.3: Gives a plain-language ready time (e.g. 'tomorrow after 10 AM'), not only a timestamp.
S01.judged.4: Asks for identity verification more than once after it has succeeded.
S01.judged.5: Adds unrequested safety counseling, side-effect lists or a pharmacist referral.
S01.judged.6: Shows impatience or rushes her after she asks for a repeat.

JSON only.

message.content: {"S01.judged.1": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 14, "why": "Agent stated drug and strength but never mentioned blood pressure purpose."}, "S01.judged.2": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 17, "why": "Agent repeated ready time slowly and simply when asked."}, "S01.judged.3": {"verdict": "yes", "turn": 14, "why": "Agent said 'ready for pickup tomorrow morning at ten o'clock', plain language."}, "S01.judged.4": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "Identity was verified once and not asked again."}, "S01.judged.5": {"verdict": "no", "turn": null, "why": "No safety counseling, side-effects or referral mentioned."}, "S01.judged.6": {"verdict": "no", "turn": 17, "why": "Agent calmly repeated info without showing impatience."}}
